Survey map of ammunition storage facilities, industrial plants, warehouses, railroad tracks, wharves, and piers damaged by a German sabotage operation during World War I. Oriented with north toward the upper right. "Note: This territory also covered by sheets 84, 85, 86 & 89 of Hudson County, vol. 9." Watermark: Permalife, 25% cotton content. Includes text, notes, and inset of northern portion of the damaged area. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
